stories.title: Quantum observers can 'agree to disagree,' but within limits, new theorem shows
stories.desc: Two observers can start with the same description of a quantum system, follow the same probability rules and still disagree about the chance of the same outcome—even while being certain of each other's assessments.

stories.title: Will it flow? Simulating food inks for 3D printing
stories.desc: In "Star Trek," characters use a technology called a replicator to produce any food item they can imagine out of thin air. While we don't have this same technology in real life, we can get close with 3D printing.

stories.title: Rapid-Scan Satellite Data Offer Clues to Typhoon Intensity
stories.desc: High-frequency wind estimates derived from Fengyun-4B satellite images reveal changing typhoon structure and may improve short-term intensity predictions.
